serviceMigration.locationRefusedMessage: The service cannot start the VPN because its installation path or directory permissions failed a security check. Reinstall the service to restore its files and permissions, then try again.
serviceMigration.title: Service update required
serviceMigration.message: The Locus service version does not match the version required by this app. Choose Reinstall Service to uninstall the existing service and install the required version.
serviceMigration.checkingMessage: Checking the system service status and current running mode. Please wait…
serviceMigration.unavailableMessage: The Locus service is required and is not available. Install or repair it, then try again. Locus cannot turn the VPN on without it.
serviceMigration.success: The Locus service was updated successfully

errors.stateRefreshFailed: Failed to refresh the service state

sysproxyPrivilege.title: Could not set the system proxy
sysproxyPrivilege.message: Locus was not allowed to change the system proxy. Installing the Locus service lets it make proxy changes with your permission, and this prompt will not come back.
sysproxyPrivilege.alternative: If you would rather not install the service, turning system proxy off in Locus also stops this prompt.
sysproxyPrivilege.installing: Installing the system service. This may ask for permission.
sysproxyPrivilege.restarting: Service installed. Restarting the core through it…
sysproxyPrivilege.tunTitle: TUN mode needs the system service
sysproxyPrivilege.tunMessage: TUN mode needs the Locus service to take over network traffic. Once it is installed, TUN mode will be turned on for you.

subscription.expiredHint: Your Locus subscription has ended. Contact the person who sold you the code to renew it, then activate again.
subscription.unconfirmedHint: Locus has not confirmed your subscription with the server yet. Connect once on a working network and this will update.

errors.restartCoreStopFailed: The core could not be stopped safely, so the restart was cancelled
errors.quitCoreStopFailed: The core could not be stopped safely, so quitting was cancelled
